title: High-Value Shoppers Across Multiple Months
prompt: A fashion ecommerce platform tracks when shoppers add items to their cart. The marketing team wants to identify shoppers who demonstrated strong engagement in BOTH February 2024 AND March 2024. Specifically, a shopper qualifies if they added items worth at least $500 to their cart in February 2024 AND added items worth at least $500 to their cart in March 2024. Write a query that returns the `shopper_id` and `shopper_email` of all qualifying shoppers. Order the results by `shopper_id` ascending. Note: A single cart addition event belongs to exactly one month, so you must aggregate across multiple rows to check both thresholds.
schema_ddl: CREATE TABLE cart_additions (addition_id INT PRIMARY KEY, shopper_id INT NOT NULL, shopper_email VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, item_value DECIMAL(10, 2) NOT NULL, added_at DATE NOT NULL);
example_input_data: INSERT INTO cart_additions (addition_id, shopper_id, shopper_email, item_value, added_at) VALUES (1, 101, 'alice@example.com', 300.00, '2024-02-05'), (2, 101, 'alice@example.com', 250.00, '2024-02-15'), (3, 101, 'alice@example.com', 400.00, '2024-03-10'), (4, 101, 'alice@example.com', 150.00, '2024-03-20'), (5, 102, 'bob@example.com', 600.00, '2024-02-08'), (6, 102, 'bob@example.com', 200.00, '2024-03-12'), (7, 103, 'carol@example.com', 700.00, '2024-02-22'), (8, 103, 'carol@example.com', 800.00, '2024-03-18');

composite_moves: group-aggregate with HAVING on multiple slice thresholds

hints: You need to check if each shopper meets a spending threshold in two different months.
Use GROUP BY on shopper_id and shopper_email, then use conditional aggregation with SUM(CASE WHEN ...) to calculate totals for each month separately.

In the HAVING clause, require that SUM(CASE WHEN DATE_TRUNC('month', added_at) = '2024-02-01' THEN item_value ELSE 0 END) >= 500 AND SUM(CASE WHEN DATE_TRUNC('month', added_at) = '2024-03-01' THEN item_value ELSE 0 END) >= 500.
answer_key: SELECT shopper_id, shopper_email FROM cart_additions GROUP BY shopper_id, shopper_email HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN DATE_TRUNC('month', added_at) = DATE '2024-02-01' THEN item_value ELSE 0 END) >= 500 AND SUM(CASE WHEN DATE_TRUNC('month', added_at) = DATE '2024-03-01' THEN item_value ELSE 0 END) >= 500 ORDER BY shopper_id;

_meta.scenario: a fashion ecommerce site tracking add-to-cart and conversion
